data: same E.coli/PaxDb joins, CDS>=90nt; original nested_cv accession pool
outer: 5-fold shuffled seed7, same genes for all views
inner: RidgeCV13 logspace alphas1e-3..1e3 with3fold shuffle seed=outer fold index; training-only fitting
metrics: pooled OOF Pearson r and RMSE versus log10 ppm target
uncertainty: paired gene-index bootstrap5000 seeded draws over fixed OOF predictions,2.5/97.5percentiles for r and differences
limits: fixed-model/fixed-fold conditional gene bootstrap not independent training uncertainty or external-expression validation; related genes/polyclonal operons may violate iid sampling; no causality, optimization benefit or biological fold change
